title: The wall's nail holes
logline: The flyer wall, close, between two flyers: the shingle pocked with twenty-nine years of pin holes, some from the low row that rose in 2020. The page counts holes the way it counts flyers.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of a shingle wall between two paper flyers, the wood pocked with hundreds of old pin holes, some in a lower band.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an extreme close-up of a shingle wall between two paper flyers with the wood pocked by hundreds of old pin holes, some in a lower band, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Counts holes the way it counts flyers.
